collection.description: A family has lost a pregnancy they had hoped would bring a child into their home.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: A family has lost a pregnancy they had hoped would bring a child into their home. (Name1), a father, stands beside the cradle he carved, unsure whether to put it away.

choices.label: Speak with Someone Who Has Grieved
Spend Time with His Partner or Loved Ones

a1.name: Outcome A1
a1.text: He finds comfort in leaving it where it is.

a2.name: Outcome A2
a2.text: Seeing it hurts, and he later asks someone to move it.

b1.name: Outcome B1
b1.text: He feels less alone without being told to move on.

b2.name: Outcome B2
b2.text: Their experiences differ, but the conversation still matters.

c1.name: Outcome C1
c1.text: He carves a symbol and places it in a quiet spot.

c2.name: Outcome C2
c2.text: He begins the carving but cannot finish it yet.

d1.name: Outcome D1
d1.text: They share memories and sit together without forcing words.

d2.name: Outcome D2
d2.text: They grieve differently and agree to give each other space.
